close_auction_rule.label: 规则1：冲高回落尾盘竞价卖出
close_auction_rule.condition: cumulative upper shadow > cumulative candle body

methodology: Each stock receives one equal capital slot; all slots start in cash.
One-minute signals are observed at minute close and fill on the next tradable minute.
SHORT exits obey T+1 and remain latched until the next tradable minute.
At 14:56, a held stock with cumulative upper shadow larger than its candle body exits at the 15:00 closing auction price.
Daily and monthly returns use the same full-market marked-to-close NAV.

One-minute OHLCV cannot prove queue position at price limits.
The current non-ST universe retains survivorship bias.
